scope: Unchanged released decoders (decodeFullAnnotator) of a whole transaction of each era from Shelley to Conway at the era's decoder version (2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9): before Alonzo the RecD record ShelleyTx definite, non-empty indefinite and detached, with a flag and with the wrong number of items; from Alonzo decodeRecordNamed AlonzoTx with and without its validity flag, definite and indefinite, a boolean third item without auxiliary data after it, a non-boolean third item of four, the wrong number of items, heads that disagree with the items and a detached envelope; for each accepted transaction the transaction id the decoders hash and its encCBOR at the era's version (the bytes a node relays for it); no ledger rule, signature or script is run
referenceNode: 11.1.3 (matching embedded ledger package versions, not a bit-identical node release build)

alonzoTx.note: decodeRecordNamed AlonzoTx over the body, witnesses, a flag read when the third item is a boolean and the auxiliary data (532-553); toCBORForMempoolSubmission writes Rec AlonzoTx of four items (489-513)

coders.note: decodeCount (RecD cn) n reads the list head around a decoder that reads nothing; the fields are read after it by ApplyD (482, 499-502)

decoder.note: decodeRecordNamed checks a definite list's count after its fields and an indefinite list's break (654-708)

core.note: wireSizeTxF: the size of the encCBOR of a transaction at the era's version (667-679); read at the pin

consensusMempool.note: a held transaction is sent as wrapCBORinCBOR toCBOR tx (256-259); read at the consensus pin, not run by the harness

sourceArchive.kind: repository tarball at the pinned commit

harness.image: scarab-conway-decoding:local (run as scarab-cc688-conway-decoding:local, whose /oracle/conway-decoding/Main.hs has this sha256), from scripts/oracle/conway-decoding/Dockerfile on scarab-plutus176-context-reference:local
